text: たくさん　あつめた　ニドラン　しんか　して　ほしくない　けど…

structure.jp: たくさん　あつめた　ニドラン
structure.en: the Nidoran I collected lots of

structure.jp: しんか　して　ほしくない　けど…
structure.en: I don't want them to evolve, but...

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.span: しんか　して　ほしくない
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb followed by ほしい means you want someone else to do it; ほしくない is the 'don't want' form. しんか　して　ほしくない = 'I don't want them to evolve'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たくさん　あつめた　ニドラン
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that...' in English. たくさん　あつめた　ニドラン = 'the Nidoran that I collected lots of'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but'; left hanging at the end, it leaves the rest unsaid. ほしくない　けど = 'I don't want it, but...'.
